learning_outcomes.text: Read the three primary financial statements
Interpret profitability, liquidity and leverage ratios
Explain the difference between profit and cash
Apply basic investment appraisal to a decision
Explain budgeting, cost behaviour and variance
Connect financial metrics to management decisions

integrative_case: A department head receives a budget pack, a profitable monthly P&L, and a warning from finance about cash. They must explain to their team why profit and cash differ, read the relevant ratios, and choose between two small investments using simple appraisal, then present the reasoning to the finance director.
